notes.title: HANZ Puppetguns | Day 1 Patch
notes.notes:
Hi guys! Thanks for playing our game. It still has some bugs, but we work on it.
Here is day 1 patch log:

1) Mouse cursor stays confined in game window.
2) Room list of players is added.
3) Fix some small network issues.

Best regards,
Dimle!

notes.title: HANZ Puppetguns | Release
notes.notes:
Our little bunny overcame all difficulties. He broke through the zombie wolves and destroyed all the enemies on his way.

HANZ Puppetguns is available for purchase on Steam store from today on the starting price of 0 $. Yes, it's absolutely free!

Hanz is ready to take the brunt and receive a feedback from all sides!

We will be happy if you like Hanz Puppetguns!

Have a good game!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33242706/06634189b1d1f179776bb8903ddb98a117b34193.jpg

notes.title: Release date has changed!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!
Hanz had a little trouble with his furry legs (after the zombie wolf sneaked up and bit), so we have to postpone the release date to August 15, 2018.
Bunny is already on the mend and is going to take a good revenge!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33242706/7c53546ca0d9bc7a2e690ce0c9fcf417b1fba445.png
